body:
## Summary
The first Launchpad UI looked like a generic AI-made template: an emoji logo, the default indigo button, a purple gradient banner, all-caps micro labels, a feature-card grid, a "Copy" button under every paragraph, and raw `**markdown**` on the page. This PR replaces it with a quiet, editorial design that shows the product instead of describing it.

**It's live now:** https://launchpad-2rdynba3hkaq.vercel.app

**Stacked on #6.** The base is `launchpad`, so this diff is only the UI. Merge #6 first.

### What changed
- **Design system:**
  - Paper background, near-black type, and hairline rules instead of boxes.
  - Black primary buttons, with one green reserved for "live".
  - Inter font. No emoji, no gradients. Dark mode works.
- **Landing page:** leads with a real kit preview (the timeline plus an X post) instead of four feature cards. The numbers only appear once there are launches.
- **Kit page, now a working tool:**
  - Posts are styled like their platform (X shows as a thread with character counts), and copy buttons sit quietly in each post's corner.
  - The Launch YC body renders as Markdown and copies as Markdown.
  - Once you're live, results come first: big numbers and per-channel bars.
  - A sticky sidebar holds Launch now, the posting timeline and the launch-day checklist.
- **Mobile:** Launch now comes first, then the plan and the posts. The timeline and checklist sit below them instead of before every post.
- **Form:** grouped into sections, with outline-and-check channel chips.
- **Boost page and ops log:** rebuilt on the same system.
- **Fixes:**
  - Plurals ("1 squad founder was asked", "1 boost").
  - The public log shows a clean kit summary (the plan's first sentence plus the timing) instead of truncated raw Markdown.
  - Readable radar sources ("Show HN", not "show hn").
  - Footer spacing.

Every page was checked in a headless browser at 1280px and 390px, with realistic seeded data.

## What we need from you
1. **Review the look** on the live site: `/`, `/new`, `/ops`, and a kit page (submit a test launch with your own email, then untick "list my launch").
2. Same open asks as #6: a **full-permission Naïve key** saved only in `key.txt`, and a **fresh anonymous X account**.

## Test plan
- [x] `cd project-2 && npm test`: 11 pass
- [x] `npm run typecheck`
- [x] Screenshots of every page (landing, form, kit while writing, ready and live, boost, ops) on desktop and mobile
- [x] Deployed: the live landing page serves the new design, with no emoji left

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commits.messageBody:

  black primary buttons, one green for "live"; Inter; no emoji or
  gradients; dark mode
- Landing page leads with a real kit preview instead of a feature grid
- Kit page is a working tool: posts look like their platform, quiet
  copy buttons, results first once live, sticky sidebar with Launch now,
  the timeline and the checklist; Launch YC body renders as Markdown
- Form grouped into sections with channel chips; boost page and ops log
  rebuilt on the same system
- Fixes: plurals ("1 boost"), clean kit summaries in the public log
  instead of truncated raw Markdown, readable radar source names,
  footer spacing, mobile order (Launch now first, timeline after)
